scenes.heading: Cost & Reliability in CI/CD & Infrastructure
scenes.narration: Mature platforms balance three forces at once: keeping infrastructure reliable, keeping delivery fast, and keeping costs under control.

scenes.heading: Levers for cost
bullets: Cache dependencies and layers to shorten CI
Use spot instances for fault-tolerant batch work
Right-size resource requests to cut waste
scenes.narration: Caching dependencies and Docker layers dramatically shortens CI runtime and therefore compute cost. Spot or preemptible instances slash the price of fault-tolerant batch workloads. Right-sizing resource requests eliminates the waste of over-provisioned pods. And scaling workloads to zero when they are idle means you pay nothing for capacity you are not using.

scenes.heading: Levers for reliability
bullets: Idempotent jobs that are safe to re-run
Budgets and alerts to catch runaway spend
scenes.narration: Retries with exponential backoff smooth over transient failures without hammering downstream systems. Making jobs idempotent means a re-run produces the same result, so recovery is safe. Spreading critical services across multiple availability zones protects against zonal outages. And cost budgets with alerts catch runaway spend before the bill arrives.

scenes.heading: The cost-reliability tension
scenes.narration: A pure cost-first stance leans on aggressive spot usage and minimal redundancy, which is cheap but fragile under failure. A pure reliability-first stance runs on-demand capacity with redundancy everywhere, which is robust but expensive. The art is matching the posture to how critical each workload actually is.

scenes.heading: Caching to cut CI cost
scenes.code:
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4
  - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
    with:
      python-version: "3.11"
      cache: pip
  - name: Cache dbt packages
    uses: actions/cache@v4
    with:
      path: dbt_packages
      key: dbt-${{ hashFiles('packages.yml') }}
  - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
scenes.narration: This snippet turns on pip caching so dependencies are not re-downloaded on every run. It also caches the dbt packages directory, keyed on a hash of the packages file, so the cache invalidates only when dependencies actually change. Small optimizations like these compound across thousands of CI runs into meaningful time and cost savings.

scenes.text: Treat cost and reliability as first-class design goals: measure both, tune per workload, and automate the safeguards.
scenes.narration: Treat cost and reliability as first-class design goals by measuring both, tuning the tradeoff per workload, and automating the safeguards that keep you honest.
